description:
PROGRAM_SYNTHESIS_ARC5_EXACT_FIRST.md -- the shape-first proposal rung's SHAPES, as graph-resident data (CLAUDE.md: 'a base IS a dimension'; families are held codebook data, never hand-coded per task). Each ExactFamily node names a parameter SCHEMA a bounded, deterministic Python search (domains/prog_exact.py) walks: which rational coefficients (k_numerators / k_denominators), which named CROSS-FRAME constants it may apply (constants_json -- name -> pre-computed double, applied once at the render boundary per CLAUDE.md's frame/continuum invariant: pi/sqrt2/sqrt3 are maps, never in-frame parameters), and how many integer per-argument exponents (max_exponent) it may compose. The recovered PARAMETERS themselves (k as an exact numerator/denominator pair, the exponent vector) are always integers -- only the NAMED constant's value is a float, and it sits in the map, not the frame.

Two families only, both measured (PROGRAM_SYNTHESIS_ARC5_THREE_MOVES.md, PROGRAM_SYNTHESIS_ARC5_SPECS_IMPLY_FLOATS.md) -- no speculative extras:

  scaled_power_product (order 1): k * C^p * prod(arg_i ** e_i). Recovered 82/85/139/233/276/312/606/742 (sphere volume/surface, circle circumference, cylinder lateral/volume, cone volume, degrees->radians, tetrahedron area) -- 6-8 tasks from ONE shape + a 3-4 integer parameter vector, where direct syntax search was unreachable at any size (pi is not in a term-search const pool; putting it there is a category error the frame invariant already predicts).

  sum_of_two_terms (order 2, tried only after scaled_power_product exhausts): t1 + t2, each a scaled_power_product SHARING the same (k, C) -- the one measured gap, task 574 (cylinder surface = 2*pi*r*h + 2*pi*r*r). Scoped to arity<=2 and a shared coefficient: the single measured case needs no more, and an independent-coefficient generalisation would multiply the search space and the coincidental-fit risk with no measured justification (named honestly as a residual in the design doc, not built speculatively).

Denominators are the divisors of 360 (1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12,15,18,20,24,30,36,40,45,60,72,90,120,180,360) plus the small set below 8 already used by the arc-5 probe -- a bounded, principled set wide enough to recover 1/180 (degrees->radians) without an unbounded denominator search.
